proposal.root_cause: Model fails to apply DISTINCT for join-induced duplicates and misinterprets 'Which [Entity]' questions as selecting only ID/Name instead of full details
proposal.what: Update system prompt to explicitly instruct using DISTINCT when joining one-to-many tables or selecting single attributes to avoid duplicate rows, and to use SELECT * when the question asks for detail/information about an entity. Also clarify that 'Which countries' implies returning all country columns.
